discovery_only.title: Information only
discovery_only.body: There is no printing unit at this tziyun. We will never sell a delivery we cannot make.

coming_soon.title: Coming soon
coming_soon.body: We are preparing a unit here with the caretakers. Let us know you’d like to send a kvittel.

paused.title: Service paused
paused.body: Delivery here is temporarily paused. New orders are not accepted until it resumes.

no_device.title: No unit installed
no_device.body: This tziyun is listed, but no printing unit is connected yet.

service_unavailable.title: Orders are not open yet
service_unavailable.body: We are finishing the last preparations. You can let us know this tziyun matters to you.

scheduled.closed_hours: Right now the tziyun is outside service hours. Your kvittel will be printed from {when} (local time).
scheduled.shabbat: No printing on Shabbat. Your kvittel will be printed from {when} (local time).
scheduled.yom_tov: No printing on Yom Tov. Your kvittel will be printed from {when} (local time).
scheduled.device_offline: The unit is reconnecting. Your kvittel will wait safely in the queue and print when it is back — or you can request a refund at any time.
scheduled.maintenance: The unit is under maintenance. Your kvittel will be scheduled for when service resumes — or you can request a refund at any time.

hours.title: Service hours
hours.policy: No printing on Shabbat and Yom Tov, nor after midday on Fridays and the eve of Yom Tov. Orders wait safely in the queue.

grave.testIntake: Testing phase: this site has no device yet. Your kvittel will wait in the queue and will not be printed or marked delivered until a device is assigned.

what.a: Your kvittel is printed on paper at a unit beside the tziyun, cut, and released through a closed chute into the kvittel opening. You can follow every step.

prayer.a: No. We provide physical delivery of the note you wrote. We do not pray on your behalf and promise no outcome.

proof.q: How do I know it was delivered?
proof.a: An optical sensor in the chute registers the slip. “Delivered” is shown only after that confirmation. If a unit has no sensor, we say so explicitly.

privacy.q: Who can read what I write?
privacy.a: Your text is encrypted and only turned into an image at the moment of printing. Our staff cannot read it by default, it is never written to logs, and it is deleted after delivery.

language.q: Which languages can I write in?
language.a: Hebrew (with niqqud), Yiddish, English, French, Russian and other Latin or Cyrillic languages. Emoji cannot be printed — we will tell you before payment.

handwriting.q: Can I send my own handwriting?
handwriting.a: Yes. Upload a photo; you can rotate it and adjust contrast. We never change or ‘correct’ your words.

shabbat.q: What about Shabbat and Yom Tov?
shabbat.a: Units do not print on Shabbat and Yom Tov, nor after midday on the eve. Your kvittel waits in the queue and prints afterwards.

uncertain.a: Sometimes the hardware cannot confirm a step — for example, if power is lost mid-print. We never reprint automatically; a person checks and contacts you.

refund.a: If your kvittel was not delivered because of a fault, maintenance or a pause, you can choose a later delivery or a full refund.

account.a: No. You can order as a guest. An account lets you see history and save names — only with your explicit consent.

multi.q: Can I send to several tziyunim?
multi.a: Yes — add several tziyunim to one kvittel, or write different kvittlach. Orders with more than one delivery receive a bundle discount.

video.a: Not yet. A private delivery clip (showing only the slot, never people) is planned and will only be offered where installed and approved.

requestGrave.body: Requests guide where we seek permission to install the next unit. We do not sell delivery anywhere without a unit on site.
